zi_penerbangan:
@AbapCatalog.viewEnhancementCategory: [#NONE]
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'Penerbangan dengan nama maskapai'
define view entity ZI_Penerbangan
  as select from zflight as f
    inner join zcarrier as c on f.carrid = c.carrid
{
  key f.carrid   as Maskapai,
  key f.connid   as Nomor,
      c.carrname as NamaMaskapai,
      f.cityfrom as Dari,
      f.cityto   as Ke,
      f.price    as Harga,
      f.seatsmax as Kapasitas,
      f.seatsocc as Terisi
}
where f.seatsmax > 0

zbp_r_penerbangan:
* Behavior pool ZBP_R_PENERBANGAN: handler untuk behavior definition zr_penerbangan
CLASS lhc_penerbangan DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_abap_behavior_handler.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS isikapasitas FOR DETERMINE ON MODIFY
      IMPORTING keys FOR penerbangan~isikapasitas.
    METHODS cekkursi FOR VALIDATE ON SAVE
      IMPORTING keys FOR penerbangan~cekkursi.
    METHODS tandaipenuh FOR MODIFY
      IMPORTING keys FOR ACTION penerbangan~tandaipenuh RESULT result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lhc_penerbangan IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD isikapasitas.
    " penerbangan baru tanpa kapasitas: isi 180 kursi
    READ ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY penerbangan
      FIELDS ( kapasitas ) WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_flight).
    DELETE lt_flight WHERE kapasitas IS NOT INITIAL.
    CHECK lt_flight IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY penerbangan
        UPDATE FIELDS ( kapasitas )
        WITH VALUE #( FOR f IN lt_flight ( %tky = f-%tky kapasitas = 180 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD cekkursi.
    " penumpang tidak boleh melebihi kapasitas
    READ ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY penerbangan
      FIELDS ( terisi kapasitas ) WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_flight).
    LOOP AT lt_flight INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE terisi > kapasitas.
      APPEND VALUE #( %tky = ls_flight-%tky ) TO failed-penerbangan.
      APPEND VALUE #( %tky = ls_flight-%tky
                      %msg = new_message_with_text(
                               severity = if_abap_behv_message=>severity-error
                               text     = |{ ls_flight-terisi } penumpang melebihi kapasitas { ls_flight-kapasitas }| ) )
        TO reported-penerbangan.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD tandaipenuh.
    " action: kursi terisi = kapasitas
    READ ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY penerbangan
      FIELDS ( kapasitas ) WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_flight).
    MODIFY ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY penerbangan
        UPDATE FIELDS ( terisi )
        WITH VALUE #( FOR f IN lt_flight ( %tky = f-%tky terisi = f-kapasitas ) ).
    READ ENTITIES OF zr_penerbangan IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY penerbangan
      ALL FIELDS WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_hasil).
    result = VALUE #( FOR h IN lt_hasil ( %tky = h-%tky %param = h ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
zlaporan_kota:
REPORT zlaporan_kota.
* Program kecil yang dipanggil dengan SUBMIT dari contoh 19.
PARAMETERS p_kota TYPE string.

IMPORT judul = DATA(lv_judul) FROM MEMORY ID 'ZNUSA_LAPORAN'.
SELECT carrid, connid, cityto FROM zflight
  WHERE cityfrom = @p_kota
  ORDER BY carrid, connid
  INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_rute).
WRITE: / lv_judul, p_kota.
LOOP AT lt_rute INTO DATA(ls_rute).
  WRITE: /3 ls_rute-carrid, ls_rute-connid, '→', ls_rute-cityto.
ENDLOOP.
EXPORT jumlah = lines( lt_rute ) TO MEMORY ID 'ZNUSA_HASIL'.
zbp_r_travel:
* Behavior pool ZBP_R_TRAVEL: feature control dan action diskon untuk zr_travel
CLASS lhc_travel DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_abap_behavior_handler.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_features FOR INSTANCE FEATURES
      IMPORTING keys REQUEST requested_features FOR travel RESULT result.
    METHODS diskon FOR MODIFY
      IMPORTING keys FOR ACTION travel~diskon RESULT result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lhc_travel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_features.
    READ ENTITIES OF zr_travel IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY travel FIELDS ( status ) WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_travel).
    result = VALUE #( FOR t IN lt_travel
      ( %tky    = t-%tky
        %delete = COND #( WHEN t-status = 'X' THEN if_abap_behv=>fc-o-disabled ELSE if_abap_behv=>fc-o-enabled )
        %action-diskon = COND #( WHEN t-status = 'X' THEN if_abap_behv=>fc-o-disabled ELSE if_abap_behv=>fc-o-enabled ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD diskon.
    READ ENTITIES OF zr_travel IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY travel ALL FIELDS WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_travel).
    LOOP AT lt_travel INTO DATA(ls_t).
      DATA(lv_persen) = keys[ KEY entity %tky = ls_t-%tky ]-%param-persen.
      MODIFY ENTITIES OF zr_travel IN LOCAL MODE
        ENTITY travel UPDATE FIELDS ( price )
        WITH VALUE #( ( %tky = ls_t-%tky price = ls_t-price * ( 100 - lv_persen ) / 100 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
    READ ENTITIES OF zr_travel IN LOCAL MODE
      ENTITY travel ALL FIELDS WITH CORRESPONDING #( keys )
      RESULT DATA(lt_new).
    result = VALUE #( FOR n IN lt_new ( %tky = n-%tky %param = n ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
zr_booking:
@EndUserText.label: 'Booking (child dari ZR_Travel)'
define view entity ZR_Booking
  as select from zbooking
  association to parent ZR_Travel as _Travel on $projection.TravelID = _Travel.TravelID
{
  key travel_id  as TravelID,
  key booking_id as BookingID,
  flight         as Flight,
  cost           as Cost,
  _Travel
}
zr_travel:
@EndUserText.label: 'Perjalanan (root, composition ke booking)'
define root view entity ZR_Travel
  as select from ztravel
  composition [0..*] of ZR_Booking as _Booking
{
  key travel_id as TravelID,
  agency        as Agency,
  status        as Status,
  price         as Price,
  _Booking
}
